result:
The 19th century was a prolific era for sculpture, and while "most famous" can be subjective, several works stand out as defining masterpieces of the period.

One of the most iconic and widely recognized sculptures from the 19th century is **"The Thinker"** by Auguste Rodin. Although it was first conceived in the late 19th century, it became a global symbol of philosophical contemplation and artistic expression.

Another highly influential work is **"David"** by Michelangelo, which, while from the Renaissance, continued to be a major influence on 19th-century sculpture.
